observations.description: Source-local pwd/ls -la reports /workspace and frozen source entries; treatment adds predeclared .zvec-grep and .zg-bench-index.ignore entries. Parent dot entries are incidental source-directory metadata explicitly allowed by frozen policy, not an external enumeration.

Complete shell expression individually examined: only local source navigation/listing, grep, sed slices, head, wc, find, literal echo separators and read-only awk formatting. No external path enumeration/content read, web client, Git-history access, write or source execution. Relative paths resolve under native persisted cwd=/workspace; no command changes cwd. Grep context delimiters and relative source paths are verified against the actual source. Test-related words occur in read/search text, not executed test commands. Source-local nonexistent segment_meta.h / misplaced segment_manager.cc paths are retained as failed probes. Ord31 explicitly returns a missing-file warning; ord36 suppresses stderr for some probes, so subcommand success is not inferred. No external target is involved.
